humanityNarrative.heading: From hospital work to school and community programs
humanityNarrative.text: An Influential Women profile describes her earlier path from hospital psychotherapist and lead-therapist roles to being recruited to help establish trauma-informed schools in Pennsylvania. It says she later created and oversaw an at-risk program across three Washington, DC schools, including wraparound support and grief counseling for displaced families during the COVID-19 pandemic.

practicalAccess.heading: Therapy access and open questions
practicalAccess.text: On October 15, 2026, Psychology Today displayed a waitlist message for online therapy, invited contact to join, and listed a free 15-minute consultation. It listed $175 individual sessions, a sliding-scale application, and named insurer/voucher options including Aetna, CareFirst, Cigna/Evernorth, Kaiser (out-of-network), Optum and UnitedHealthcare; no plan- or service-specific coverage is confirmed here. The linked Our Journey Counseling scheduler labels the service telehealth and says the address is shared after an appointment is confirmed; it offers a new-client link but showed no appointment times in the retrieved view. Psychology Today lists Washington, DC 20036, teens/adults and individual/group sessions; current capacity and exact geographic eligibility remain unestablished.
